total_note: Everything priced so far, for two
intro: Your ferries, island transfers and the sunset cruise, arranged through Original Senses, my partner in Athens. A deposit locks them in; the balance is due a month before you land.

transfers.title: All four island transfers
transfers.note: Paros port to Vione, Vione to Paros port, Santorini port to Andronis Arcadia, and Andronis Arcadia to Santorini airport. Luxury vehicle with an English-speaking driver.

ferries.title: Athens to Paros, later afternoon ferry
ferries.note: A later sailing so there is time for your stop in Athens first. The afternoon sailings for May 2027 are not on sale yet; I will book one as soon as they are published. Met at Paros port and driven to Vione.

ferries.title: Paros to Santorini, Champions League Jet 1

boats.title: Private sunset caldera cruise on a Pardo 43
boats.note: Fresh fish, salads, dips, cheese and charcuterie, dessert, wine and beer, snorkel gear and a paddleboard, hotel transfers both ways.

pending_note: The afternoon ferries from Athens to Paros for May 2027 are not published yet. Once one is booked it is added to your trip total and paid with the balance, so the deposit stays as it is. Your own driver is covering the Athens airport pickup and the Zara stop, so that transfer is not included here; if you would rather I arrange one, I am happy to price it.

optional.title: Private full day to Antiparos, Despotiko & Panteronissia
optional.note: Axopar 28 with your own captain, towels, snorkel gear, water toys, snacks and drinks, hotel transfers both ways.

optional.title: Or a half day on the bigger Axopar 37
optional.note: Same islands, shorter day, more boat.

how: The deposit is set by Original Senses under their terms: 25% of transfers and experiences, the full ferry fare and 30% of private boat charters. The balance is due 30 days before you arrive. Boats and ferries go fast in high season, so it is worth locking them in early.
